name: Fyfster Pack Quantity Rules for WooCommerce
author: fyfster

sections.description:
Sell bottles by the case, supplies by the box, or any selected product in quantity multiples. Set a pack size of 6, for example, to accept 6, 12, 18, and other multiples of 6.

  • Show the pack size beside the product quantity field. Standard WooCommerce product forms offer quick choices for one, two, and three packs.
  • Preview the first valid quantities while editing the product.
  • Give shoppers quick corrections for a single cart line when WooCommerce allows the suggested quantity.
  • Validate pack quantities in both classic and block checkout.

Quantities are combined across cart lines for the same product or variation. Each variation meets the parent product’s pack rule independently. The plugin supports classic checkout and the Cart and Checkout blocks.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce and Fyfster Pack Quantity Rules for WooCommerce.
  2. Edit a simple or variable product and open Product data > General.
  3. Enter Units per pack and save. Clear the field to remove the rule.
